specification_compliance: Checked the three listed findings against the working tree at the reviewed commit. Each describes test or source files that are present and whose content matches the claim. None of the three is a spec-invariant violation, so no invariant was found broken by these findings alone.

The scenes.py loft_source trust path (SPEC-ADDON-117 I12/I13 style classification) returns 200 for 'youtube', rejects other non-null values with 400, and falls back to read_loft only when loft_source is NULL. This matches the design comment at scenes.py:59-61.
potential_unspecified_behavior: For a .loft whose loft_source is NULL and whose drive is not mounted, _require_youtube_loft catches only LoftUnreadable and turns it into 400 'Not a video file' (scenes.py:67-72). The spec does not say whether an unreadable reference on the scenes route should answer 400 or another status. This was not reproduced.
regression_risks: The scenes route now trusts the indexed loft_source column over the .loft file. If that column is stale, the route can serve or refuse scenes incorrectly until the next fetch updates it. Not reproduced.
